pages: Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, sits at the third console with one open log book in front of him and a pencil in his fist. Middle distance: a telephone handset, the switchboard of neighbouring desks. Background: the long control room, dim evening light.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, faces one large black dial on the wall with a single white needle, watching it hold steady. Middle distance: his console desk, an open log book. Background: the control room, low evening light.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, has one telephone handset at his ear and his eyes on the mimic board, where a red block has appeared on the north line. Middle distance: his log book, the console keyboard. Background: the long control room, dim light.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, stands at his console with one hand flat under the wall dial, watching its white needle fall and then climb back. Middle distance: the open log book, the mimic board. Background: the control room, dim evening light.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, writes one line of figures in the log book with a pencil, stopping to read it back. Middle distance: the wall dial above his desk, the mimic board. Background: the control room, dim evening light.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, runs one finger down the printed list of plants on the console, stopping at the order of calls. Middle distance: the open log book, a pencil. Background: the mimic board, dim control room light.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, copies the hydro order down in his log with one pencil, naming three plants in a line. Middle distance: the printed plant list, the console keyboard and headset. Background: the mimic board, dim evening light.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, works a sum on the back of one log sheet with a pencil, holding the corner flat. Middle distance: the console keyboard, the printed plant list. Background: the mimic board, dim evening light.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, ticks three unstarted machines off the plant list with one pencil, then strikes one out again. Middle distance: the log sheet with his sum, the console keyboard. Background: the mimic board, dim evening light.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, stands close to the mimic board with one pencil raised, reading the loading figures off the north line rather than its colour. Middle distance: his log book on the console. Background: the control room, dim evening light.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, writes the time in the margin of one open log book with a pencil, pressing hard. Middle distance: the console keyboard, the printed plant list, his headset. Background: the mimic board, dim evening light.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, takes one telephone handset from the console and holds it to his ear, eyes on the mimic board. Middle distance: his open log book, the printed plant list. Background: the control room, dim evening light.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, sits very still at the console with one open log book, adding the losses in its columns with a pencil held still. Middle distance: the headset on its cradle, the printed plant list. Background: the mimic board, dim evening light.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, stands under the wall dial with one hand at his side, watching the white needle settle back from the drop. Middle distance: his open log book on the console, the headset. Background: the mimic board, dim evening light.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, runs one finger down the printed plant list for the last time and stops at the bottom margin. Middle distance: his open log book, a pencil laid across it. Background: the mimic board, dim evening light.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, holds one telephone handset hard against his ear and speaks the number into it, seated squarely at the console. Middle distance: his open log book, the printed plant list. Background: the mimic board, dim evening light.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, writes the whole evening into one open log book with a pencil, in a very quiet room. Middle distance: the headset back in its cradle, the printed plant list. Background: the mimic board, dim evening light.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, works down one filled log sheet with a pencil, checking each line against the console. Middle distance: his open log book, the printed plant list. Background: the mimic board, the quiet dim control room.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, comes in and finds one log book still standing open on his desk where he left it. Middle distance: a pencil, the printed plant list. Background: the mimic board, spring daylight through the high windows.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, sits on the Friday night bus with one folded log sheet on his knee and his forehead against the window. Middle distance: the seat back, the grab rail. Background: dark hills sliding past, lit carriage.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, holds one torn corner of log paper in his hand and pushes it into his pocket. Middle distance: his open log book on the desk, a phone. Background: the corridor windows, morning daylight.

Wiremu Rangi, a young man of eighteen in an orange hi-vis vest over a grey work shirt, reads one printed instruction sheet at the induction bay counter, finger stopped on a plant name. Middle distance: his log book, a hard hat on the shelf. Background: the noticeboard of plant diagrams, flat office light.
